_comment: Rename map for the HOLDOUT corpus (SPEC-94 S5; see PROVENANCE.md): original public-domain names -> invented replacements, longest-first so multi-word names replace before their parts. Real-world places, people and nations (London streets, Italy, Henry the Eighth) keep their names; the novel's people, houses and home counties do not. `spans` cuts five single-narrator sections out of the source (Collins restarts chapter numbering per narrator and heads some sections with bare numerals), each under its own excerpt heading; `sections` lists those headings.

spans.heading: CHAPTER I
spans.start: The heat had been painfully oppressive all day

spans.heading: CHAPTER II
spans.start: When I rose the next morning and drew up my blind

spans.heading: CHAPTER III
spans.start: I write these lines at the request of my friend

spans.heading: CHAPTER V
spans.start: It is the grand misfortune of my life that nobody will let me alone.
spans.end: THE STORY CONTINUED BY ELIZA MICHELSON
